opening.argument: The video promotes cloud mining as passive income, supplies a registration referral, and directs viewers to buy hashrate, including a stated $20 minimum, to begin earning. The mining dashboard displays hashrate, pool information, and income or forecast columns, while the speaker recommends a pool as the most profitable and reports prior profit of $1.76. He also states that withdrawal commissions were increased. These are concrete features of a paid mining and return offer, although the available evidence does not establish actual payouts or losses. Nor does it establish that the separate ICO bonus was connected to the mining offer.
